findings.detail:
Political donation timeline:
2016: $10K to Nimble America (pro-Trump 501c4), used pseudonym NimbleRichMan on Reddit
2017: Fired from Facebook/Oculus reportedly over political activity
2024: $400K to Trump campaign, co-hosted fundraiser at John Word home ($100K/person)
2025: $175K+ in FEC-reported donations. Key recipients:
  - $50K WinRed
  - $50K One Team Senate Majority  
  - $13.2K Calvert Victory Fund
  - $8K NRSC
  - $5K each: Eureka PAC, Lincoln Club of OC, New Majority Federal PAC, Anduril PAC, Hispanic 100 PAC
  - $3.5K each: Whatley, Sullivan, Rogers, Hinson, Crank, Desmond campaigns
All donations list employer as 'Anduril Industries Inc' or variants.

Anduril PAC established: receives employee contributions. Key PAC donors include Chris Brose (former SASC staff director), Gregory Kausner (former DoD official), Matthew Steckman (COO), Megan Milam (registered lobbyist).

Conservative network: Member of Rockbridge Network (LittleSis entity 423815). Israel visit Feb 2026 organized by Josh Wolfe (Lux Capital co-founder, early Anduril investor) — met PM Netanyahu, senior defense officials, 10 Israeli defense startups including Smart Shooter, Kela, Skana Robotics.

Key pattern: Luckey uses personal wealth and Anduril corporate apparatus to build political influence across Republican establishment, then translates that influence into defense contracts. The PAC ensures Anduril employees are also politically invested.

Defense oversight committee donations: $17K to Ken Calvert (HASC), $3.5K Tim Scott (SASC), $3.5K Dan Sullivan (SASC), $3.5K Rogers for Senate, $3.5K Mullin for America (SASC), $3.5K Young Kim for Congress, $1.5K Hyde-Smith (SASC), $1.5K Banks for Senate.
